---
title: Tables with the same headers
weight: 1
---

Tables 1, 2 and 3 have the same headers. Tables 4 and 5 have other headers.
The number in the name of a table is its place in the page, so table 5 is
"(table 5)" and not "(table 2)".

| Command | What it does |
| ------- | ------------ |
| serve   | Starts the server |

Table 2.

| Command | What it does |
| ------- | ------------ |
| setup   | Asks for the settings |

Table 3.

| Command | What it does |
| ------- | ------------ |
| doctor  | Checks the setup |

Table 4.

| Flag     | Meaning |
| -------- | ------- |
| --listen | The address to listen on |

Table 5.

| Flag     | Meaning |
| -------- | ------- |
| --token  | The token to use |
